title: NOLs and estimated tax — Pell Robotics
instructions: Pell Robotics (calendar year) has 2025 taxable income of **$600,000** before any NOL deduction and an NOL carryforward of **$900,000** from 2022. It isn't a large corporation. Its 2024 tax was **$100,000**.

rows.label: 2025 NOL deduction
rows.explanation: Post-2017 NOLs are limited to 80% of taxable income: 80% × 600,000 = **480,000**.

rows.label: Minimum total 2025 estimated payments to avoid the penalty
May the 2022 NOL be carried back?
rows.explanation: Post-2020 NOLs (other than farming) carry forward only.

rows.label: Is the fourth estimated payment for a calendar-year corporation due December 15?
rows.explanation: Corporate installments are due on the 15th of the 4th, 6th, 9th and 12th months.
